tools.name: corporate_capital_budgeting
tools.description: Project NPV, IRR, MIRR, fractional payback, profitability index and equivalent annual annuity. Runs Capital budgeting (corporate.capital_budgeting, version 2) on the given inputs and returns its canonical result: the validated inputs, the outputs, the warnings and the manifest. Every number carries its unit in the input schema; rates are decimals.
